description: HP-96 is the Registration and Licensing Authority (RLA) located in Dheera, Himachal Pradesh, operating under the jurisdiction of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM). It primarily handles the registration of private (non-transport) vehicles and the issuance of driving licenses for the Dheera sub-division. The office is part of the newer series of registration codes established to serve the growing administrative needs of the Kangra district.
address: Office of the Sub Divisional Officer (Civil), Dheera, District Kangra, Himachal Pradesh
